data.name: Project JS
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

"You are the chosen one of Nezha. This time, it is your turn to walk the path of divinity."

As the successor to Jay, the novel's protagonist, you become the predestined Spirit Medium (Jishen) chosen by the Third Prince Nezha. In this battle against malevolent spirits, you will wield Pogs as sacred artifacts to exorcise demons. However, wielding divine power comes at a cost: you must endure the searing agony it inflicts, learning the brutal exchange between power and sacrifice.

Your journey centers around the mysterious Dongfeng Market. You will fight your way through challenging levels, ascending to the market's rooftop for a final showdown with the Demon King of the Sixth Heaven. As a protagonist burdened with heavy sins, the "Karma" you accumulate through exorcism will be the key to your redemption. To avoid plummeting into the Eighteen Levels of Hell, you must remain virtuous at all times.

Will you join us on this journey of atonement?

Pogs Battle System

Players will randomly obtain Pogs that act as divine catalysts. You must utilize these Pogs to execute effective combat strategies while striving to collect a diverse deck of artifacts for various tactical applications.

Sacrifice-Driven System

As the Spirit Medium of the Third Prince, every time you use a Pog, your health (HP) is converted into raw offensive kinetic energy. The true challenge lies in cautiously balancing your damage output with your remaining life force.

Environmental Narrative System

From the East Wind Market and Traditional Chinese Pharmacies to the Rooftops, Mazu Temples, and even Hell itself—each environment triggers unique events and features NPCs that reflect the nature of their surroundings, deepening the immersion of the world.

data.short_description: You are the one chosen by Nezha. This time, you will carry out justice on behalf of Heaven. The player takes on the role of the next Jishen, successor to the novel’s protagonist Jay, becoming the chosen one of Nezha and using pog card to battle demons and spirits.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
